checks.coverage: All 12 defined state/input combinations checked twice

limitations: Development verification only; official evaluation has not occurred.
State codes 110 and 111 and unknown inputs are unspecified by the original problem; no correctness claim is made for them.
justified_rtl_changes: Initial implementation computes the next-state bit 1 from the six specified state transitions. Default output is zero for unspecified state encodings to keep combinational assignments complete. No RTL revisions.
justified_tb_changes: Initial independent testbench uses the complete destination-state table, checks destination bit 1 after combinational settling, and includes a bounded timeout. No testbench revisions.
interface_cycle_contract: TopModule(y[2:0], w, Y1); combinational next-state bit only, no clock, reset, extra ports, or pipeline latency.
static_review: Complete combinational case assignments, single output driver, explicit three-bit state codes and one-bit outputs.
